description: The try function moves on from a function that fails
notes: The README says try moves on from an argument that produces errors, but the spec's call rules don't say that a function that fails makes its call an error (see native/functions/function-error-is-eval-error). hashicorp/hcl reports the function's error as an error in the call (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), so try moves on to the next argument (try in ext/tryfunc/tryfunc.go).
